Stage 3: Pre-DE Preparation + QC

Bo Yu, Si Liu, Wei Sun

2026-02-27

Load experiment object

library(jaxExperiment)

expt_file = file.path("outputs", "experiment.rds")
expt = load_experiment(expt_file)
expt
## <jax_experiment>
##   dataset_name: JAX_RNAseq13
##   release_label: December 2025 release
##   config: output_prefix=2025_12_JAX_RNAseq13, release_dir=/fh/fast/sun_w/MorPhiC/data/MorPhiC_internal_releases/MorPhiC_Release_December_2025/JAX_RNAseq13
##   metadata_file: /fh/fast/sun_w/MorPhiC/data/MorPhiC_internal_releases/MorPhiC_Release_December_2025/JAX_RNAseq13/metadata/JAX_RNAseq13_metadata_CORRECTED_FinalVersion.xlsx

Filter counts and compute QC metrics

spec3 = stage3_spec_default()
expt = stage3_prepare_de(expt, spec = spec3)
## Stage3 pre-DE preparation:
##   - Alignment: reordered count columns to match unified metadata.
##   - Input matrix: genes=38592, samples=45
##   - Gene annotation filter: keeping 38592 / 38592 genes.
##   - q75 filter (per model_system): keeping 25649 / 38592 genes (rule: q75 > 0 in at least one model_system).
##   - Filtered matrix: genes=25649, samples=45

Filtering summary

knitr::kable(expt$counts_filtered$zero_filter$per_group, row.names = FALSE)
group n_samples n_genes_q75_gt_0
ENDO 18 24067
MESO 27 23668

Read depth vs expression quantile (q75)

stage3_plot_depth_vs_quantile(
  expt,
  color_by = "ko_strategy",
  shape_by = "model_system"
)

stage3_plot_depth_vs_quantile(
  expt,
  color_by = "run_id",
  shape_by = "model_system"
)

PCA of WT samples

expt = stage3_compute_wt_pca(expt, spec = spec3)
## Stage3 pre-DE preparation: WT PCA
##   - WT samples: 15
##   - Genes kept for PCA (WT q75>0): 24333 / 25649
stage3_plot_wt_pca(expt, color_by = "model_system")

stage3_plot_wt_pca(expt, color_by = "run_id")

PCA within each model system + day + condition

expt = stage3_compute_de_group_pca(expt)
## Stage3 pre-DE preparation: DE-group PCA
##   - PCA group definition: model_system, timepoint_value, condition
##   - PCA groups: 2
stage3_plot_de_group_pca(expt)

Optional: merge / correct run IDs (after PCA review)

run_id_recode = c(
  "20250724_GT25-RobsonP-125-run2" = "20250702_GT25-RobsonP-125"
)

if (!is.null(run_id_recode)) {
  expt = stage3_recode_run_id(expt, recode = run_id_recode, strict = TRUE)
}
## Stage3 run_id recode: updated run_id for 1 samples (run IDs 3 -> 2).
## Stage3 run_id recode: applied the following run ID merges:
##                      run_id_old                run_id_new n_samples
##  20250724_GT25-RobsonP-125-run2 20250702_GT25-RobsonP-125         1

Save experiment object (for later stages)

save_experiment(expt, expt_file)
